metadata.title: Kinematics in galactic tidal tails - A source for Hypervelocity stars?

notes: No eligible individual stars are identifiable in the supplied paper. It is a simulation study of tidal debris, and its HVS references are collective rather than named stars (e.g., T:p1-b11: “Recent observations of 17 stars in the Galactic halo”; T:p5-b0: “Observed HVSs”), with no stellar names or source identifiers. Simulation particles and numbered simulation runs are not identified stars.
